summary: Dairy processor asks whether in-line spectroscopy can track protein concentration in a relatively clear whey stream before a concentration stage, with lab results as reference; the stream may become turbid under some operating conditions and the concept must handle this.

facts_stated.text: Whey stream upstream of a concentration stage, described as relatively clear
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: Our dairy process includes a relatively clear whey stream before a concentration stage

facts_stated.text: Goal: track protein concentration as the stream changes
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: We want to investigate whether spectroscopy can track protein concentration as the stream changes

facts_stated.text: Stream can become more turbid under some operating conditions
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: The stream can become more turbid under some operating conditions

targets.enquiry_quote: track protein concentration as the stream changes

heterogeneous.enquiry_quote: The stream can become more turbid under some operating conditions

customer_premises.claim: A first measurement concept can be designed that handles turbidity changes without further process data
